# Freelance Client Handoff Builder

## Purpose
Turn completed and verified work into a client-friendly handoff that makes the deliverable usable and reduces avoidable follow-up.

## Workflow
1. Confirm the agreed deliverables and the evidence that each is complete.
2. List files, links, versions, locations, and access prerequisites using only details actually supplied.
3. Write concise usage or maintenance notes appropriate to the deliverable.
4. Record known limitations, open issues, dependencies, and items explicitly excluded from scope.
5. Include verification evidence only when available; label unchecked items UNVERIFIED.
6. Prepare a handoff message draft and a client acceptance checklist.
7. Identify optional future work separately so it is not presented as already included.

## Output
Handoff inventory, usage notes, verification evidence, known limitations, open items, acceptance checklist, and a message draft.

## Safety and limits
- Never include passwords, API keys, private tokens, personal data, or secrets in handoff material.
- Do not transfer ownership, grant account access, deploy, publish, send messages, or change permissions.
- Do not claim completion without evidence.
- No paid tools or APIs. No runtime activation or tool grants.

CEOAI-authored workflow. Draft-only; human-reviewed.
